summary: Phase-2 (Profiles + Local Discovery + Top 8) verified end-to-end. Backend 15/15 pytest cases passing in /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_geo.py: (a) PATCH /api/profile/me {zip_code:'10001'} → 200 + zip set; {zip_code:'abcde'} → 400 'Please enter a valid 5-digit US ZIP code.'; {zip_code:''} → clears; (b) GET /api/profile/by-username/tfone PUBLIC payload OMITS zip_code, while GET /api/auth/me INCLUDES zip_code for the owner; (c) presence_visible toggle PATCHes and persists via /auth/me; (d) Radius gate — posts with snapshot author_lat/author_lng on creation, /api/posts?radius=20&viewer=tfone returns tfone's TEST_radius_post_phase2, /api/posts?radius=10&viewer=tftwo (no ZIP) → 400 'Radius Search requires a ZIP code in your Profile Settings.', radius=any and no-radius work normally; (e) Top-8 add by friend id persists in /auth/me.inner_8, non-friend id → 400, 9 ids → 400 'Inner 8'. Private fields author_zip/author_lat/author_lng stripped from every post in response payloads. Frontend verified live: AccountSettings ZIP+Presence cards work (toggle aria-pressed flips and persists), profile view (?edit=0) shows profile-username-row + profile-presence-indicator, edit mode reveals profile-top8-editor with stealth in slot #1 — remove/add/picker/pick-stealth-back flow works and persists across refresh, feed-radius-bar has all 7 chips testids feed-radius-{any,10,20,50,100,250,500}, default Any has data-active=true, clicking 20 as tfone (with ZIP) activates without modal, while tftwo (no ZIP) clicking 20 triggers feed-zip-required modal with the EXACT spec text and feed-zip-required-go navigates to /settings/account. Sounds page uses Dropdown testid root 'sounds-radius' (button = sounds-radius-button, opts = sounds-radius-opt-{Any|10 mi|...|500 mi}) — all 7 options present, default Any.

integration_issues.issue: Input strips non-digit/hyphen chars client-side via setZip(value.replace(/[^0-9-]/g,'').slice(0,10)) in AccountSettings.jsx:225. Typing 'abcde' becomes '' before save, so the user never sees backend's 'Please enter a valid 5-digit US ZIP code.' — instead they see 'ZIP cleared.' Spec wanted error message surfaced. Backend rejection path (catch → setZipMsg(detail)) is wired correctly but unreachable. Either remove the strict input mask OR add a 5-digit length check on submit that uses the same error string.

design_issues.screen: Sounds radius dropdown — spec testid mismatch
issues: Spec calls for [data-testid=sounds-radius-toggle] and 'sounds-radius-option-10 mi'. Actual code uses the shared Dropdown component which emits root testid 'sounds-radius', button 'sounds-radius-button' and options 'sounds-radius-opt-{label}' (e.g. 'sounds-radius-opt-10 mi'). All 7 options present; only the naming pattern differs from spec.

design_issues.screen: Top8Editor remove button — nested button hydration warning
issues: Top8Editor.jsx:142 renders an outer <button> (replace-slot) with an inner <button data-testid=top8-remove-{username}> (X icon). React hydration warning 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>'. Cosmetic — both clicks still work because the inner button calls e.stopPropagation() — but should be a <span role=button> or a sibling element.

action_items: (Minor UX/Spec) AccountSettings ZIP input: surface backend's 'Please enter a valid 5-digit US ZIP code.' for non-numeric input. Either remove the input mask, or add explicit `if (zip && !/^\d{5}$/.test(zip.trim())) { setZipMsg('Please enter a valid 5-digit US ZIP code.'); return; }` before the PATCH call.
(Minor) Optionally rename Sounds Dropdown testid from 'sounds-radius' to 'sounds-radius-toggle' to match spec, or update spec docs to reference the actual Dropdown pattern.
(Cosmetic) Top8Editor: refactor the inner remove <button> to <span role='button'> (or move it outside the parent <button>) to eliminate the nested-button hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: core/geo.py is clean: ZIP_RE strict, pgeocode lru_cache prevents repeated dataset loads, NaN guards on lat/lng, radius_filter EXCLUDES items without coords (matches spec).

routers/profile.py PATCH /me handles all three ZIP states correctly: empty-string clears (zip_code/zip_lat/zip_lng → None), invalid → 400, valid+geocode-fail → 400, valid+geocode-ok stores prefix + coords. Inner-8 friend membership check + 8-cap enforced.

routers/posts.py snapshots author_zip/author_lat/author_lng at create time so changing a user's ZIP later does NOT retroactively relocate old posts — correct privacy/semantics. _public_post strips all three private fields from every response shape (list, single get, feed-by-user, create).
Frontend Top8Editor optimistic UI + rollback on error is correct (setIds(next) then PATCH, rollback to user.inner_8 on failure). refreshMe() re-fetches /auth/me so widgets stay in sync.

ZipRequiredModal text matches spec verbatim ('Radius Search requires a ZIP code in your Profile Settings.') and the Go CTA navigates to /settings/account via react-router useNavigate — no full-page reload, no broken state.
Feed.jsx default Any has data-active=true and only fires the ZIP-required modal when user.zip_code is empty AND a non-Any radius is selected — matches spec.

rca_of_the_issue: ZIP invalid-input UX gap: AccountSettings.jsx:225 onChange handler uses setZip(e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9-]/g, '').slice(0, 10)). Effect: when a user types 'abcde', the field becomes '' synchronously; clicking Save then sends zip_code:'', which the backend treats as a CLEAR (200) — the UI shows 'ZIP cleared.' instead of the spec's 'Please enter a valid 5-digit US ZIP code.' Fix options: (1) remove the regex mask; (2) keep the mask but in saveZip(), assert that the user *intended* non-empty input — track the raw onChange value separately, or simply require length === 5 before sending. Backend itself is fully correct (test_invalid_zip_returns_400 passes against the API directly).
